content.label: Identity & Vision
content.title: A DESTINATION WHERE CRICKET PASSION MEETS PERFORMANCE.
content.lead: Jimmy Sports Club was conceived with a clear vision: to elevate sporting culture in Muzaffarpur and provide cricketers of all skill levels with the quality infrastructure they deserve.
content.body: More than just a playing ground, JSC is where young athletes build discipline, competitive players hone their technique, and cricket enthusiasts come together under floodlights. By combining an all-weather artificial turf, covered training nets, automated bowling simulators, and dedicated academy coaching, JSC is empowering the next generation of cricketing talent across Bihar.

content.label: State-Of-The-Art Infrastructure
content.title: BUILT FOR EVERY MATCH & DRILL.
content.description: Explore JSC's specialized cricket facilities engineered for competitive match play, technical practice, and intense repetition.

cards.title: FLOODLIT CRICKET TURF
cards.description: Muzaffarpur's premier artificial cricket turf featuring an all-weather playing surface, full boundary safety netting, and high-lux tournament floodlights for thrilling night matches.
features: Professional artificial turf with true, predictable bounce
High-lux LED floodlight towers for clear night play
Marked center pitch strip & regulation crease lines
Ideal for 6v6, 8v8 box cricket & club friendlies

cards.title: COVERED CRICKET PRACTICE NETS
cards.description: Dedicated weather-protected cricket practice nets with high-density impact enclosures, allowing bowlers and batsmen to train without weather interruptions.
features: Covered overhead structure protecting from rain & sun
Heavy-gauge safety nets with multiple practice lanes
Full bowling run-up and regulation batting crease
Suited for pace, seam, and spin bowling sessions

cards.title: AUTOMATED BOWLING MACHINE
cards.description: High-precision cricket bowling simulator delivering consistent deliveries to groove your batting mechanics, footwork against pace, and stroke execution.
features: Programmable speeds from 70 km/h to 130+ km/h
Inswing, outswing, leg-break, and off-spin delivery controls
Targeted line & length repetition (Bouncers, Yorkers, Good Length)
Packages available from 10 overs up to 70 overs

content.label: Player Development Pathway
content.title: JIMMY SPORTS CLUB ACADEMY
content.description: Cultivating technical excellence, game intelligence, and competitive spirit in aspiring young cricketers across Muzaffarpur and Bihar.
paragraphs: JSC Academy provides young players with an all-round development environment. Our coaching methodology blends orthodox fundamentals with modern training aids—including automated bowling simulators, video analysis feedback, and regular match simulations on the turf.
Whether learning the first forward defensive stroke or preparing for district and school tournaments, our trainees benefit from dedicated focus, fitness drills, and consistent net practice.

highlights.title: Technical Stance & Grip
highlights.description: Emphasis on balance, head position, backlift, and orthodox footwork against pace and spin.

highlights.title: Bowling Action Mechanics
highlights.description: Biomechanical guidance for fast bowlers and spinners to build rhythm, consistency, and avoid injury.

highlights.title: Machine Repetition
highlights.description: Controlled bowling machine sessions to ingrain muscle memory on cuts, pulls, and drives.

highlights.title: Match Simulation
highlights.description: Regular competitive scenario matches on the all-weather floodlit turf under pressure situations.

items.author: Verified Cricket Player
items.text: The turf quality at Jimmy Sports Club is unmatched in Muzaffarpur. The bounce is true, the lighting for night matches is exceptionally bright, and the staff manages slot bookings smoothly over WhatsApp.

items.author: Local Tournament Organizer
items.text: We hosted our weekend night tournament here. The floodlights give great visibility, the perimeter nets keep the game contained, and the all-weather surface holds up perfectly. Highly recommended for cricket enthusiasts.

items.author: Academy Parent
items.text: Having covered nets and an automated bowling machine right here in Muzaffarpur is a game changer for young cricketers. My son gets consistent practice on his front-foot strokes every week.
